purpose: Frozen eight-file workload for the revised, measured-host P2-F feasibility pilot. No result is recorded here.

ci_reference.note: Per-file elapsed values are read from this production run at the pinned tree. Every listed file passed there; none is censored.

command.note: Same runner and job count as the production fast gate; NOT the shard flags. Per-file elapsed is the comparable quantity, not total CI wall.

acceptance.host: every expected_host field must match measured values; label alone insufficient
acceptance.integrity: warm-up + five measured artifacts; exactly eight paths per run; every status pass; zero timeouts/failures/missing
acceptance.stability: (max total wall - min total wall) / median total wall <= 0.15 over the five measured runs
acceptance.comparability: for each file, median(pilot)/ci_elapsed in [0.5,2.0]; pooled median ratio in [0.67,1.5]
acceptance.isolation: one runner per invocation; no nested runner or shard flags; the only .github addition is the dispatch-only pilot workflow (no push/PR trigger, no test selection)
acceptance.provenance: cache state, preparation overhead, load, exact argv and measured host per run; warm-up excluded from statistics
